execution_contract: This is an audited launch manifest, not a claim that experiments have run. Substitute variables before invoking each argv; do not pass argv through a shell.

SOURCE must be a task-owned isolated source copy at the pinned commit with empty experiments/runs, baselines/runs, baselines/records, and results. Preserve upstream/ as imported evidence. Keep checkpoints/ and experiments/recipes/.
Materialize the frozen recipes listed below inside SOURCE only. Never overwrite published records in upstream/.

Set CRAM_DATA and V1_DATA to DATA, THIRD_PARTY to THIRD_PARTY, PYTHONPATH to SOURCE where needed; record actual Python, torch, CUDA, driver, host, GPU UUID, source hash, data hashes, command argv and environment in every local run.
Freeze all choices before testing. Imported choices may define a frozen-recipe reproduction but are not new local tuning evidence. Do not tune from test results.
One timed fit per physical GPU; protect with a per-GPU lock and recheck processes before dispatch. CPU-only tasks should not reserve a GPU.
A skipped output must have a verified local provenance and configuration; inherited result files must never satisfy dependencies.
GPU timing is Blackwell on these machines, not the paper H200. Record warm and cold timings separately. Claim cross-method speed ratios only from locally matched hardware/protocol.
Successful released-weight evaluations and smoke runs are validation stages, not completion of from-scratch training, full test evaluation, or ablations.
